title: "will" in statements
text: I'll/We'll/You'll/They'll/He'll/She'll go plogging in the park this Saturday morning.
Hi, everyone! My name is Yang Ling. I want to start a cleaning group.

In the group, we ________ (make) posters to ask others to join. We will ________ (clean) a different place every Saturday. This weekend, we ________ (help) in Happy Tree Park. I ________ (bring) the rubbish bags.
Who wants to join? It ________ (be) a busy but wonderful day!
sentences: I want to start a cleaning group.
We will clean a different place every Saturday.
It will be a busy but wonderful day!
